Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL4649962. Join assays, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to exact measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
